  "plan": "1. Remove the oversized old model to free disk space.

3. Train a new model with dim=200, wordNgrams=2, epoch=10, lr=0.7 on lowercased text (based on fasttext paper results for Yelp Full).

    {
      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
import pandas as pd
import os

os.makedirs('/app/work', exist_ok=True)

# Read training data, shuffle, and split 90/10
df = pd.read_parquet('/app/data/train-00000-of-00001.parquet')
df = df.sample(frac=1, random_state=42).reset_index(drop=True)
n_valid = int(len(df) * 0.1)
valid_df = df[:n_valid]
train_df = df[n_valid:]

for name, data in [('train_lower', train_df), ('valid_lower', valid_df)]:
    out = f'/app/work/{name}.txt'
    with open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        for label, text in zip(data['label'], data['text']):
            text = str(text).lower().replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ').strip()
            text = ' '.join(text.split())
            f.write(f'__label__{label} {text}\n')
    print(f'wrote {out}, size={os.path.getsize(out)/1024/1024:.1f}MB, lines={len(data)}')

# Read and process test data
df_test = pd.read_parquet('/app/data/test-00000-of-00001.parquet')
out = '/app/work/test_lower.txt'
with open(out, 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for label, text in zip(df_test['label'], df_test['text']):
        text = str(text).lower().replace('\n', ' ').replace('\r', ' ').strip()
        text = ' '.join(text.split())
        f.write(f'__label__{label} {text}\n')
print(f'wrote {out}, size={os.path.getsize(out)/1024/1024:.1f}MB, lines={len(df_test)}')
PY
